questions.body_en:
According to the pattern below, what is the English letter in the space?
B, D, G, I, L, N, __
questions.body_id:
Dựa vào quy luật dưới đây, chữ cái tiếng Anh trong chỗ trống là chữ gì?
B, D, G, I, L, N, __

highlights.phrase_en: what is the English letter in the space
highlights.phrase_id: chữ cái tiếng Anh trong chỗ trống là chữ gì
highlights.note_en: Find the next letter by continuing the +2/+3 alternating gap pattern
highlights.note_id: Temukan huruf berikutnya dengan melanjutkan pola selang +2/+3 bergantian

highlights.phrase_en: B, D, G, I, L, N, __
highlights.phrase_id: B, D, G, I, L, N, __
Dựa vào quy luật dưới đây
highlights.note_en: The pattern alternates: skip 1 letter (+2), then skip 2 letters (+3), repeating
highlights.note_id: Polanya bergantian: lewati 1 huruf (+2), lalu lewati 2 huruf (+3), berulang

strategy.name_en: Find the gap pattern and apply it
strategy.name_id: Temukan pola selang lalu terapkan

trap.why_en: Adding only +2 each time gives P, but the pattern alternates +2 and +3 — the 7th step needs +3.
trap.why_id: Menambah +2 setiap kali menghasilkan P, tapi polanya bergantian +2 dan +3 — langkah ke-7 memerlukan +3.

hint_steps_en: Write the alphabet positions: B=2, D=4, G=7, I=9, L=12, N=14.
The pattern alternates +2, +3, +2, +3, +2 — so the next gap is +3.
N is position 14; 14+3 = position 17 = Q.
hint_steps_id: Tulis posisi alfabet: B=2, D=4, G=7, I=9, L=12, N=14.
Polanya bergantian +2, +3, +2, +3, +2 — jadi selang berikutnya adalah +3.
N adalah posisi 14; 14+3 = posisi 17 = Q.

params.intro_en: Check each consecutive gap in the sequence to find the alternating pattern.
params.intro_id: Periksa setiap selang berurutan dalam barisan untuk menemukan pola bergantian.
params.final_en: The alternating +2/+3 pattern means N→Q — answer is Q.
params.final_id: Pola +2/+3 bergantian berarti N→Q — jawabannya adalah Q.
params.aria_en: Sequence gaps alternate between plus 2 and plus 3; after N the next gap is plus 3, giving Q.
params.aria_id: Selang barisan bergantian antara plus 2 dan plus 3; setelah N selang berikutnya adalah plus 3, menghasilkan Q.

questions.body_en: 23 children form a column. There are 8 children behind Alice. How many child(ren) is/are in front of her?
questions.body_id: 23 đứa trẻ tạo thành một hàng dọc. Có 8 trẻ đứng sau Alice. Hỏi có bao nhiêu trẻ đứng trước cô ấy?

highlights.phrase_id: 23 đứa trẻ tạo thành một hàng dọc
highlights.note_en: Total count in the line is 23
highlights.note_id: Jumlah total dalam barisan adalah 23

highlights.phrase_id: 8 trẻ đứng sau Alice
highlights.note_en: 8 people are behind her, plus Alice herself = 9 accounted for from the back
highlights.note_id: 8 orang di belakangnya, ditambah Alice sendiri = 9 yang sudah terhitung dari belakang

highlights.phrase_en: How many child(ren) is/are in front of her
highlights.phrase_id: có bao nhiêu trẻ đứng trước cô ấy
highlights.note_en: Count everyone who is NOT Alice and NOT behind her
highlights.note_id: Hitung semua yang BUKAN Alice dan BUKAN di belakangnya

strategy.name_en: Total minus (Alice + those behind)
strategy.name_id: Total dikurang (Alice + yang di belakang)

trap.why_en: 23 − 8 = 15 forgets to subtract Alice herself from the total.
trap.why_id: 23 − 8 = 15 lupa mengurangi Alice sendiri dari total.

hint_steps_en: There are 23 children total in the column.
8 children are behind Alice — plus Alice herself = 9 children from the back.
Children in front = 23 − 9 = 14.
hint_steps_id: Ada 23 anak total dalam barisan.
8 anak di belakang Alice — ditambah Alice sendiri = 9 anak dari belakang.
Anak di depan = 23 − 9 = 14.

questions.body_en: When Edward was born, mum was 27 years old. Brother was born 1 year later. When mum is 46 years old, how old will brother be?
questions.body_id: Khi Edward sinh ra, mẹ 27 tuổi. Em trai sinh ra 1 năm sau. Khi mẹ 46 tuổi, em trai bao nhiêu tuổi?

highlights.phrase_en: When Edward was born, mum was 27 years old
highlights.phrase_id: Khi Edward sinh ra, mẹ 27 tuổi
highlights.note_en: This sets the age reference: at Edward's birth, mum=27
highlights.note_id: Ini menetapkan referensi usia: saat Edward lahir, ibu=27

highlights.phrase_id: Em trai sinh ra 1 năm sau
highlights.note_en: When brother was born, mum was 28 and brother was 0
highlights.note_id: Saat adik lahir, ibu berusia 28 dan adik berusia 0

highlights.phrase_en: When mum is 46 years old, how old will brother be
highlights.phrase_id: Khi mẹ 46 tuổi, em trai bao nhiêu tuổi
highlights.note_en: Age difference between mum and brother is always 28 years
highlights.note_id: Selisih usia ibu dan adik selalu 28 tahun

strategy.name_en: Fixed age gap — subtract from mum's target age
strategy.name_id: Selisih usia tetap — kurangi dari usia target ibu

trap.why_en: Using mum's age 27 (Edward's birth) instead of 28 (brother's birth) gives 46−27=19, which is wrong.
trap.why_id: Menggunakan usia ibu 27 (saat Edward lahir) bukan 28 (saat adik lahir) menghasilkan 46−27=19, yang salah.

hint_steps_en: When Edward was born: mum = 27.
Brother was born 1 year later: mum = 28, brother = 0.
The age gap between mum and brother is always 28 years.
When mum = 46: brother = 46 − 28 = 18.
hint_steps_id: Saat Edward lahir: ibu = 27.
Adik lahir 1 tahun kemudian: ibu = 28, adik = 0.
Selisih usia antara ibu dan adik selalu 28 tahun.
Saat ibu = 46: adik = 46 − 28 = 18.

questions.body_en:
What is the value of the number to represent "?" in the following table?
(Table: row 1: 1, 2, 2 | row 2: 3, 4, 12 | row 3: 5, 6, 30 | row 4: 7, 8, ?)
questions.body_id:
Giá trị của số biểu diễn "?" trong bảng dưới đây là bao nhiêu?
(Bảng: hàng 1: 1, 2, 2 | hàng 2: 3, 4, 12 | hàng 3: 5, 6, 30 | hàng 4: 7, 8, ?)

highlights.note_en: 1×2=2, 3×4=12, 5×6=30 — the third column is column 1 × column 2
highlights.note_id: 1×2=2, 3×4=12, 5×6=30 — kolom ketiga adalah kolom 1 × kolom 2

highlights.note_en: Apply the same rule: 7 × 8 = ?
highlights.note_id: Terapkan aturan yang sama: 7 × 8 = ?

highlights.phrase_en: What is the value of the number to represent "?"
highlights.phrase_id: Giá trị của số biểu diễn "?"
highlights.note_en: Multiply the two values in row 4
highlights.note_id: Kalikan dua nilai di baris 4

strategy.name_en: Spot the rule across rows, then apply it
strategy.name_id: Temukan aturan di setiap baris, lalu terapkan

hint_steps_en: Look at row 1: 1, 2, 2 → is the third number the sum? 1+2=3 ✗. Product? 1×2=2 ✓.
Rule: third column = first × second.
hint_steps_id: Lihat baris 1: 1, 2, 2 → apakah angka ketiga adalah jumlah? 1+2=3 ✗. Perkalian? 1×2=2 ✓.
Konfirmasi: baris 2: 3×4=12 ✓; baris 3: 5×6=30 ✓.
Aturan: kolom ketiga = pertama × kedua.

highlights.phrase_id: Nhóm 1–4 cho thấy quy luật tăng dần của ký hiệu # xếp theo hình
highlights.note_en: Count the # in each group to find the difference sequence

highlights.phrase_id: có bao nhiêu # trong nhóm thứ 6
highlights.note_en: Extend the pattern two more steps beyond Group 4
highlights.note_id: Perpanjang pola dua langkah lagi setelah Kelompok 4

highlights.phrase_id: Dựa vào quy luật dưới đây

highlights.note_id: Gambar diperlukan untuk membaca jumlah pasti Kelompok 1–4

Periksa apakah selisihnya membentuk pola sendiri (misalnya, setiap selisih bertambah dengan jumlah tetap).

questions.body_en: Find the value of 28 + 11 + 23 + 39 + 32 + 17.
questions.body_id: Tìm giá trị của 28 + 11 + 23 + 39 + 32 + 17.

highlights.note_en: Six numbers to add — group pairs that sum to round numbers first
highlights.note_id: Enam angka yang dijumlahkan — kelompokkan pasangan yang hasilnya bilangan bulat dulu

highlights.phrase_id: Tìm giá trị của
highlights.note_en: Compute the total sum
highlights.note_id: Hitung jumlah totalnya
Strategi berpasangan: 28+32=60, 11+39=50, 23+17=40

strategy.name_en: Pair numbers that sum to round numbers
strategy.name_id: Pasangkan angka yang berjumlah bilangan bulat

hint_steps_en: Look for pairs that add to a round number: 28+32=60, 11+39=50, 23+17=40.
Add the three round numbers: 60+50+40=150.
hint_steps_id: Cari pasangan yang hasilnya bilangan bulat: 28+32=60, 11+39=50, 23+17=40.
Jumlahkan tiga bilangan bulat tersebut: 60+50+40=150.

questions.body_en: Find the value of 6 × 23 + 6 × 38 + 6 × 56 − 6 × 18.

highlights.note_en: Every term has a factor of 6 — factor it out using the distributive law
highlights.note_id: Setiap suku memiliki faktor 6 — keluarkan dengan hukum distributif

highlights.phrase_id: Tìm giá trị của
highlights.note_en: Simplify inside the bracket first, then multiply by 6
highlights.note_id: Sederhanakan di dalam kurung dulu, lalu kalikan dengan 6

strategy.name_en: Factor out the common factor, then compute
strategy.name_id: Keluarkan faktor persekutuan, lalu hitung

hint_steps_en: Notice every term has 6 as a factor: 6×23 + 6×38 + 6×56 − 6×18 = 6×(23+38+56−18).
Compute inside the bracket: 23+38=61, 61+56=117, 117−18=99.
hint_steps_id: Perhatikan setiap suku memiliki faktor 6: 6×23 + 6×38 + 6×56 − 6×18 = 6×(23+38+56−18).

highlights.note_en: 8 consecutive odd numbers; pair symmetric terms: 11+25=36, 13+23=36, etc.
highlights.note_id: 8 bilangan ganjil berurutan; pasangkan suku simetris: 11+25=36, 13+23=36, dst.

highlights.note_en: Each of the 4 pairs sums to 36
highlights.note_id: Setiap dari 4 pasang berjumlah 36

highlights.phrase_id: Tìm giá trị của
highlights.note_en: Multiply the pair sum by the number of pairs
highlights.note_id: Kalikan jumlah pasang dengan banyaknya pasang

strategy.name_en: Pair first and last terms (Gauss pairing)
strategy.name_id: Pasangkan suku pertama dan terakhir (pasangan Gauss)

hint_steps_en: There are 4 pairs, each summing to 36.
hint_steps_id: Ada 4 pasang, masing-masing berjumlah 36.

highlights.note_id: Setiap suku dibagi 5 — gabungkan pembilang dulu

highlights.note_en: Sum the numerators then divide by 5
highlights.note_id: Jumlahkan pembilang lalu bagi dengan 5

strategy.name_id: Penyebut sama — gabungkan pembilang lalu bagi

hint_steps_en: Each fraction has denominator 5, so combine: (12+9+17−3) ÷ 5.
hint_steps_id: Setiap pecahan berpenyebut 5, gabungkan: (12+9+17−3) ÷ 5.

questions.body_en:
The numbers below follow the arithmetic sequence. What is the sum of the 6th number and the 9th number?
99, 92, 85, 78, 71, …
questions.body_id:
Các số dưới đây là một dãy số cách đều. Tổng của số thứ 6 và số thứ 9 là bao nhiêu?
99, 92, 85, 78, 71, …

highlights.note_en: Common difference d = 92−99 = −7
highlights.note_id: Beda umum d = 92−99 = −7

highlights.phrase_id: là một dãy số cách đều

highlights.phrase_en: What is the sum of the 6th number and the 9th number
highlights.phrase_id: Tổng của số thứ 6 và số thứ 9 là bao nhiêu
highlights.note_en: Compute a₆ and a₉ separately, then add
highlights.note_id: Hitung a₆ dan a₉ secara terpisah, lalu tambahkan

strategy.name_en: Arithmetic sequence formula — find each term, then add
strategy.name_id: Rumus barisan aritmetika — cari tiap suku, lalu jumlahkan

trap.why_en: Using d = +7 (going up) instead of −7 (going down) gives wrong terms.
trap.why_id: Menggunakan d = +7 (naik) bukan −7 (turun) menghasilkan suku yang salah.

hint_steps_en: Find the common difference: 92−99 = −7.
hint_steps_id: Cari beda umum: 92−99 = −7.

questions.body_en:
Fill the lines with '+' and '−' to make the equation below correct. (Write down the complete equation on the answer sheet).
23 __ 7 __ 11 __ 3 = 22
questions.body_id:
Điền '+' và '−' vào dòng kẻ để tạo thành phép tính đúng. (Viết phép tính hoàn chỉnh vào phiếu trả lời).
23 __ 7 __ 11 __ 3 = 22

highlights.note_en: Three blanks, each either + or −, giving 2³ = 8 combinations to try
highlights.note_id: Tiga titik kosong, masing-masing + atau −, menghasilkan 2³ = 8 kombinasi untuk dicoba

highlights.phrase_id: Điền '+' và '−' vào dòng kẻ
highlights.note_en: Only + and − are allowed, no × or ÷
highlights.note_id: Hanya + dan − yang diperbolehkan, tidak ada × atau ÷

highlights.phrase_en: to make the equation below correct
highlights.phrase_id: để tạo thành phép tính đúng
highlights.note_en: The result must equal exactly 22
highlights.note_id: Hasilnya harus tepat sama dengan 22

strategy.name_en: Try-and-eliminate — test sign combinations until one works
strategy.name_id: Coba dan eliminasi — uji kombinasi tanda sampai satu berhasil

hint_steps_en: There are 8 possible sign combinations (2×2×2).
Start with all plus: 23+7+11+3=44, too big — need to subtract some.
Subtracting a number x changes the total by −2x compared to adding it.
Need to reduce 44 by 22: so find a subset summing to 11 → just 11 itself.
hint_steps_id: Ada 8 kemungkinan kombinasi tanda (2×2×2).
Mulai dengan semua plus: 23+7+11+3=44, terlalu besar — perlu mengurangi beberapa.
Mengurangi angka x mengubah total sebesar −2x dibanding menambahkannya.
Perlu mengurangi 44 sebesar 22: cari subset yang berjumlah 11 → hanya 11 itu sendiri.

params.intro_en: Try sign combinations for 23 __ 7 __ 11 __ 3 = 22 — start from all-plus and eliminate.
params.intro_id: Coba kombinasi tanda untuk 23 __ 7 __ 11 __ 3 = 22 — mulai dari semua-plus dan eliminasi.
params.aria_en: Testing sign combinations: 23+7+11+3=44 fails, 23+7+11-3=38 fails, 23+7-11-3=16 fails, 23+7-11+3=22 succeeds.
params.aria_id: Menguji kombinasi tanda: 23+7+11+3=44 gagal, 23+7+11-3=38 gagal, 23+7-11-3=16 gagal, 23+7-11+3=22 berhasil.

questions.body_en: Determine the result of 7 × 8 + 8 × 9 + 9 × 10 − 1 × 1 − 2 × 2 − 3 × 3 is odd or even.
questions.body_id: Xác định kết quả của 7 × 8 + 8 × 9 + 9 × 10 − 1 × 1 − 2 × 2 − 3 × 3 là lẻ hay chẵn.

highlights.note_en: Check parity of each product: even×odd=even; odd×odd=odd
highlights.note_id: Periksa paritas setiap hasil kali: genap×ganjil=genap; ganjil×ganjil=ganjil

highlights.phrase_en: Determine the result of 7 × 8 + 8 × 9 + 9 × 10 − 1 × 1 − 2 × 2 − 3 × 3 is odd or even
highlights.phrase_id: Xác định kết quả của 7 × 8 + 8 × 9 + 9 × 10 − 1 × 1 − 2 × 2 − 3 × 3 là lẻ hay chẵn
highlights.note_en: even+even+even−odd−even−odd = even−even = even
highlights.note_id: genap+genap+genap−ganjil−genap−ganjil = genap−genap = genap

highlights.phrase_id: là lẻ hay chẵn
highlights.note_en: Use parity rules without computing the exact value
highlights.note_id: Gunakan aturan paritas tanpa menghitung nilai persisnya

strategy.name_en: Parity analysis — classify each product as odd or even
strategy.name_id: Analisis paritas — klasifikasikan setiap hasil kali sebagai ganjil atau genap

hint_steps_en: A product is odd only if BOTH factors are odd; otherwise it's even.
7×8=even, 8×9=even, 9×10=even, 1×1=odd, 2×2=even, 3×3=odd.
Expression = even+even+even − odd−even−odd = (3 evens) − (odd+even+odd).
odd+odd = even, so we subtract even from even sum → result is even.
hint_steps_id: Hasil kali ganjil hanya jika KEDUA faktor ganjil; selain itu genap.
7×8=genap, 8×9=genap, 9×10=genap, 1×1=ganjil, 2×2=genap, 3×3=ganjil.
Ekspresi = genap+genap+genap − ganjil−genap−ganjil = (3 genap) − (ganjil+genap+ganjil).
ganjil+ganjil = genap, jadi kita kurangi genap dari jumlah genap → hasilnya genap.

questions.body_en: What is the smallest 3-digit number that can be divisible by 7 and 4?
questions.body_id: Số nhỏ nhất có 3 chữ số chia hết cho cả 7 và 4 là số nào?

highlights.phrase_id: chia hết cho cả 7 và 4
highlights.note_en: Must be divisible by LCM(7, 4) = 28
highlights.note_id: Harus habis dibagi KPK(7, 4) = 28

highlights.phrase_id: Số nhỏ nhất có 3 chữ số
highlights.note_en: Find the first multiple of 28 that is ≥ 100
highlights.note_id: Cari kelipatan 28 pertama yang ≥ 100

highlights.phrase_id: chia hết cho cả 7 và 4
highlights.note_en: 7 and 4 share no common factors, so LCM = 7×4 = 28
highlights.note_id: 7 dan 4 tidak memiliki faktor persekutuan, jadi KPK = 7×4 = 28

strategy.name_en: Find LCM, then the first 3-digit multiple
strategy.name_id: Cari KPK, lalu kelipatan 3-angka pertamanya

trap.why_en: 100 ÷ 7 = 14.28... not a whole number, so 100 is not divisible by 7.
trap.why_id: 100 ÷ 7 = 14,28... bukan bilangan bulat, jadi 100 tidak habis dibagi 7.

hint_steps_en: Divisible by both 7 and 4 means divisible by LCM(7, 4).
Since gcd(7, 4)=1, LCM = 7×4 = 28.
Find the smallest multiple of 28 ≥ 100: 28×3=84 (2-digit), 28×4=112 ✓.
hint_steps_id: Habis dibagi 7 dan 4 berarti habis dibagi KPK(7, 4).
Karena fpb(7, 4)=1, KPK = 7×4 = 28.
Cari kelipatan 28 terkecil yang ≥ 100: 28×3=84 (2-angka), 28×4=112 ✓.

questions.body_en:
If A, B and C are 1-digit numbers, find the value of B + C.
  B A
+  C B
= 1 6 2
questions.body_id:
Nếu A, B và C là các số có 1 chữ số, tìm giá trị của B + C.
  B A
+  C B
= 1 6 2

highlights.phrase_en: A, B and C are 1-digit numbers
highlights.phrase_id: A, B và C là các số có 1 chữ số
highlights.note_en: Each of A, B, C is between 0 and 9
highlights.note_id: Masing-masing A, B, C antara 0 dan 9

highlights.phrase_id:
B A
+  C B
= 1 6 2
highlights.note_en: Column addition: units A+B; tens B+C; hundreds carry must produce 1
highlights.note_id: Penjumlahan kolom: satuan A+B; puluhan B+C; ratusan carry harus menghasilkan 1

highlights.phrase_en: find the value of B + C
highlights.phrase_id: tìm giá trị của B + C
highlights.note_en: Work column by column from right to left using carries
highlights.note_id: Kerjakan kolom per kolom dari kanan ke kiri menggunakan simpanan

quantities.value: A+B=12 (carry 1) since A+B=2 gives no hundreds carry

quantities.label_en: Tens: B+C+1 ends in 6, carry 1 to hundreds
quantities.label_id: Puluhan: B+C+1 berakhir 6, simpan 1 ke ratusan

strategy.name_en: Column-by-column carry analysis
strategy.name_id: Analisis simpanan kolom per kolom

trap.why_en: If A+B=2 (no carry), then B+C=16 is possible but the hundreds column gives 0, not 1.
trap.why_id: Jika A+B=2 (tanpa simpanan), maka B+C=16 mungkin tetapi kolom ratusan menghasilkan 0, bukan 1.

hint_steps_en: Hundreds digit of the sum is 1, so there must be a carry from the tens column.
Units column: A+B must end in 2 with carry 1, so A+B=12.
Tens column: B+C + carry(1 from units). This must end in 6 with carry 1 to hundreds, so B+C+1=16, giving B+C=15.
hint_steps_id: Digit ratusan dari jumlah adalah 1, jadi harus ada simpanan dari kolom puluhan.
Kolom satuan: A+B harus berakhir 2 dengan simpanan 1, jadi A+B=12.
Kolom puluhan: B+C + simpanan(1 dari satuan). Ini harus berakhir 6 dengan simpanan 1 ke ratusan, jadi B+C+1=16, menghasilkan B+C=15.
Verifikasi: misal B=9, C=6, A=3 → BA=93, CB=69, 93+69=162 ✓. B+C=15 ✓.

questions.body_en: What is the greatest 4-digit odd number by using 0, 2, 4, 6 and 9? (Each digit can only be used once).

highlights.phrase_id: Số lẻ lớn nhất có 4 chữ số
highlights.note_en: Odd means units digit must be 9 (the only odd digit available)
highlights.note_id: Ganjil berarti digit satuan harus 9 (satu-satunya digit ganjil yang tersedia)

highlights.phrase_id: tạo bởi các chữ số 0, 2, 4, 6 và 9
highlights.note_en: Available digits: {0, 2, 4, 6, 9} — choose any 4 of these
highlights.note_id: Digit yang tersedia: {0, 2, 4, 6, 9} — pilih 4 dari ini

highlights.phrase_en: Each digit can only be used once
highlights.phrase_id: Mỗi chữ số chỉ được dùng một lần
highlights.note_en: After fixing units=9, maximize thousands then hundreds then tens from {0,2,4,6}
highlights.note_id: Setelah menetapkan satuan=9, maksimalkan ribuan lalu ratusan lalu puluhan dari {0,2,4,6}

trap.why_en: 9642 is even (units=2), not odd — the units digit must be the odd digit 9.
trap.why_id: 9642 adalah genap (satuan=2), bukan ganjil — digit satuan harus digit ganjil 9.

hint_steps_en: Odd number requires an odd units digit. The only odd digit available is 9 → units = 9.
Remaining digits for the other 3 positions: {0, 2, 4, 6}.
To maximize, place the largest available first: thousands=6, hundreds=4, tens=2 (drop 0).
Result: 6429.
hint_steps_id: Bilangan ganjil memerlukan digit satuan ganjil. Satu-satunya digit ganjil yang tersedia adalah 9 → satuan = 9.
Digit tersisa untuk 3 posisi lainnya: {0, 2, 4, 6}.
Untuk memaksimalkan, tempatkan yang terbesar dulu: ribuan=6, ratusan=4, puluhan=2 (buang 0).
Hasilnya: 6429.

params.intro_en: The units digit must be odd — only 9 qualifies. Then fill remaining positions from largest to smallest.
params.intro_id: Digit satuan harus ganjil — hanya 9 yang memenuhi. Lalu isi posisi tersisa dari terbesar ke terkecil.

items.text_en: Units = 9 ✓ (only odd digit) — then 6, 4, 2 fill thousands, hundreds, tens → 6429
items.text_id: Satuan = 9 ✓ (satu-satunya digit ganjil) — lalu 6, 4, 2 mengisi ribuan, ratusan, puluhan → 6429

params.final_en: Units digit must be 9; filling the rest greedily gives 6429.
params.final_id: Digit satuan harus 9; mengisi sisanya secara greedy menghasilkan 6429.
params.aria_en: Digits 0, 2, 4, 6 are all even so cannot be the units digit of an odd number; only 9 is odd, giving units digit 9, then 6429 is the greatest arrangement.
params.aria_id: Digit 0, 2, 4, 6 semuanya genap sehingga tidak bisa menjadi digit satuan bilangan ganjil; hanya 9 yang ganjil, memberikan digit satuan 9, lalu 6429 adalah susunan terbesar.

quantities.value: 56−54=2? 54 and 56: digits 5,4,5,6 — repeats 5 ✗. 74−56=18; 54−16=38; 56−14=42. Closest: 76−74? only 2 digits each. Let me try: tens from {1,5}: 14 and 56 diff=42; 16 and 54 diff=38; tens from {5,7}: 54 and 76 diff=22, 56 and 74 diff=18. Min from (4,6) pair = 18

strategy.name_en: Fix the two even units digits, then pick tens digits to minimize |N1−N2|

hint_steps_en: Even 2-digit numbers need an even units digit. Even digits in the set: {0, 4, 6}.
Need 2 units digits (both even) and 2 tens digits (non-zero, distinct from each other and from units).
Try units pair (0, 6): remaining for tens from {1, 4, 5, 7}. Test 50 and 46: |50−46|=4, all digits distinct ✓.
Try units pair (0, 4): best gives |70−64|=6 or |60−54|=6.
Try units pair (4, 6): best gives 18.
Minimum difference = 4 (from 50 and 46).
hint_steps_id: Bilangan genap 2-angka memerlukan digit satuan genap. Digit genap dalam himpunan: {0, 4, 6}.
Perlu 2 digit satuan (keduanya genap) dan 2 digit puluhan (bukan nol, berbeda satu sama lain dan dari satuan).
Coba pasangan satuan (0, 6): tersisa untuk puluhan dari {1, 4, 5, 7}. Uji 50 dan 46: |50−46|=4, semua digit berbeda ✓.
Coba pasangan satuan (0, 4): terbaik memberikan |70−64|=6 atau |60−54|=6.
Coba pasangan satuan (4, 6): terbaik memberikan 18.
Selisih minimum = 4 (dari 50 dan 46).

params.intro_en: Try each pair of even units digits, pick the best tens digits, and track the minimum difference.
